Each full buyer statement is one requirement; no text normalization, truncation or attribute mapping. Gold quote criteria declared before the first and only model run. Expectations and gold quotes are not sent to the model.

implementationFreeze.note: Frozen after general source-audit and development regressions, before any v2 model request or exposure to the new parent independent set. V1 source, original input fixture and first raw reports remain preserved.
implementationFreeze.policy: Unknown may retain exact eligible relevant context; valid means quote integrity only. Unsupported known proposals remain visible as withheld conclusions. Instruction-governed spans and general decision claims are excluded with a bounded notice. Conservative bounded English guards are not a semantic proof or authentication.
